definitions.gloss: documentation; putting into writing; formalizing as a document
definitions.explanation: The act of recording information, procedures, or decisions in written form, typically for official or organizational purposes.

examples.japanese: {手順|てじゅん}を{文書化|ぶんしょか}する。
{会議|かいぎ}の{内容|ないよう}を{文書化|ぶんしょか}しておいてください。
examples.english: Please put the contents of the meeting into writing.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}ルールの{文書化|ぶんしょか}が{進|すす}んでいない。
examples.english: The documentation of company rules is not progressing.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{条件|じょうけん}はすべて{文書化|ぶんしょか}されている。
examples.english: All the contract terms have been documented.

notes:
Composed of {文書|ぶんしょ} (document, written text) and {化|か} (suffix meaning "-ization"). Refers to the process of converting spoken agreements, informal practices, or tacit knowledge into formal written documents. Common in business and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手順|てじゅん}を{文書化|ぶんしょか}する: to document a procedure
- {文書化|ぶんしょか}された{記録|きろく}: documented records
- {文書化|ぶんしょか}が{不十分|ふじゅうぶん}: insufficient documentation
- {業務|ぎょうむ}の{文書化|ぶんしょか}: documentation of tasks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {記録|きろく}: record, documentation — broader term for recording any kind of information
- {書面化|しょめんか}: putting into written form — more formal, emphasizing the physical written document
- マニュアル{化|か}: creating a manual — focuses on making instructional documents
